name: MPC Clip Bridge
author: Stampman3000
summary: LD_PRELOAD addin that exposes MPC clips over a local Unix socket (/run/mpc-ext.sock) so plugins like TrackBoy can read and write clips. Needs root SSH, writes a systemd drop-in, and restarts MPC. Verified on a Gen 1 MPC One (OS 3.10.1.12). Gen 2 packaged but untested. Original Force unsupported.
